decks.notes: The main goal of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of cheap artifacts and creatures while also generating card advantage with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Thoughtcast. The deck features a low mana curve and a focus on efficient spells and creatures to apply pressure early on. Additionally, there are cards like Galvanic Blast and Krark-Clan Shaman for removal and reach to close out games. The deck also utilizes artifact lands and affinity mechanics to quickly deploy threats and maintain a steady stream of resources throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and utilizing them to deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cheap artifacts, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and finish the game quickly. The deck includes removal spells and card draw to maintain aggression and tempo. The mana base includes artifact lands to help cast spells and trigger affinity abilities. Overall, the deck aims to be efficient and aggressive, with a focus on leveraging artifacts for maximum impact.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells, while efficiently filling the graveyard with cards like Brainstorm and Mental Note to fuel delve spells like Gurmag Angler. The deck also includes card draw spells like Deep Analysis to maintain card advantage. Unexpected Fangs provides a surprise element, while Fallaji Archaeologist and Chainer's Edict offer additional removal options. The deck aims to control the game and eventually win through efficient creature threats like Gurmag Angler.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through counterspells and removal spells while utilizing gates to generate extra mana and stabilizing the game with defensive creatures. It aims to outvalue the opponent by drawing cards, recurring threats like Squadron Hawk, and protecting key cards with Prismatic Strands. The deck has a solid mix of control elements, card advantage engines, and win conditions to outlast and outplay opposing strategies in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of small creatures and token generators in order to deal damage efficiently. Key components of the deck include cheap creatures like Thraben Inspector and Squadron Hawk, as well as token production cards like Battle Screech and Guardians' Pledge. The inclusion of cards like Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands provide removal and protection for the creatures. Additionally, cards like Kor Skyfisher and Guardians' Pledge provide support and versatility in combat. The deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to secure a victory.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on countering opponent's spells, controlling the game with removal and card draw, then closing out the game with evasive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite. The deck also includes monarch cards like Thorn of the Black Rose to gain card advantage. The mana base includes Snow-Covered Island for consistency and Contaminated Aquifer for potential card draw. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can establish a dominant board state.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently control the board while pressuring the opponent with small, evasive creatures. With a mix of counter spells and disruptive creatures like Spellstutter Sprite and Ninja of the Deep Hours, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence. By efficiently utilizing card draw and tempo plays, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through consistent damage output and control over the game.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently control the game through countering spells, eliminating threats, and drawing cards. It utilizes powerful Dimir spells like Counterspell, Snuff Out, and Gurmag Angler to maintain control while disrupting the opponent's strategy. By combining card draw with removal and counterspells, the deck aims to outlast opponents and ultimately win through either a powerful creature like Gurmag Angler or overwhelming card advantage. The inclusion of unexpected tech cards like Unexpected Fangs and Fallaji Archaeologist adds versatility to handle a variety of situations.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent, utilizing efficient creatures like Glint Hawk, Kor Skyfisher, and Thraben Inspector. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to control the board or finish off the opponent. Additionally, there are various artifacts like Relic of Progenitus and Spare Supplies to provide card advantage and utility. The deck focuses on aggressive plays and synergies between creatures and artifacts to overwhelm the opponent and secure a fast victory.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, along with a mix of low-cost creatures like Thraben Inspector and Kor Skyfisher, the deck aims to maintain board control and deal consistent damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ichor Wellspring and Makeshift Munitions provide additional value and versatility in the deck's strategy. Overall, this deck prioritizes speed and aggression to achieve victory in Pauper 1 vs 1 matches.

The main idea of this deck revolves around quickly building up a powerful creature by attaching multiple auras to it, making it difficult for the opponent to deal with. By focusing on low-cost creatures like Silhana Ledgewalker and Slippery Bogle, combined with efficient auras like Ethereal Armor and Rancor, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy. The inclusion of cards like Armadillo Cloak and Lifelink helps to increase survivability and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth to fix mana and ensure consistent draws.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells and removal spells while maintaining card advantage with Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer. Ephemerate is used to repeatedly target creatures like Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer for additional value. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements with a mix of dual lands. The inclusion of Late to Dinner and Dawnbringer Cleric provides additional utility and lifegain. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategy and outvalue them in the late game to secure victory.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to efficiently control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By utilizing cheap spells like Brainstorm, Counterspell, and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent while slowly grinding them out. The inclusion of Gurmag Angler as a finisher helps to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The deck also utilizes graveyard synergies with cards like Thought Scour and Fallaji Archaeologist to gain additional advantage.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to efficiently deal with threats on the board while maintaining card advantage with spells like Deep Analysis and Mental Note. Gurmag Angler serves as a powerful finisher, backed up by disruption spells like Spell Pierce and Snuff Out. The deck also utilizes graveyard manipulation with cards like Thought Scour and Fallaji Archaeologist to maximize its control over the game.
